differential.name: Obstructive sleep apnea syndrome
differential.rationale: Obesity, hypertension, daytime fatigue and low‑grade fever are classic sequelae of untreated OSA.

differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Documented anemia with borderline low hemoglobin can explain fatigue and low‑grade symptoms.

differential.name: Medication‑induced hypoglycemia (e.g., sulfonylurea use)
differential.rationale: Low glucose (66 mg/dL) in a pre‑diabetic patient suggests possible oral hypoglycemic exposure.

differential.name: Insulinoma
differential.rationale: Spontaneous hypoglycemia in an adult without diabetes warrants consideration of a pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor.

differential.name: Depression / stress‑related fatigue
differential.rationale: Chronic stress and drug abuse can produce non‑specific fatigue mimicking other metabolic causes.
